title: Normalized Chern and tensor-Hom twist at one scheme
statement: Let l be a prime and T a noetherian scheme on which l is a unit. For E = ULift Q_l there exists Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern] such that c is normalized, every finite evaluation is the specified finite Kummer boundary [def-sp-tower-class-finite], and tensor by its actual scalar-extended root module admits the normalized tensor/Hom equivalence Twisting [def-sp-tower-class-twisting]. This assertion has no projective model, direct image, scalar restriction to constant Z_l, or derived limit.

source.place: clauses (1), (2); line twist as in the unit proof, paragraph on Tate twists

proof.text: Construct the actual Kummer inclusion and positive-exponent power natural transformations using the prime root-transition equation and power multiplication. Their composite is zero by the kernel condition. At every level cartierProKummer_exact applies since l^(n+1) is invertible; evaluation commutes with homology, and a natural transformation is zero when all its components vanish. Thus the tower short complex is short exact, giving Kummer data k without a new existence assumption.

Apply normalized integral Kummer reduction to k to obtain r, M, the underlying-root comparison and the two adjunction-normalized derived isomorphisms. Obtain ScalarData for the actual coefficient map from semilinearScalarData and obtain its normalized coefficient-unit isomorphism from the proved scalar-unit theorem. Assemble these concrete fields into Chern c. The three supplied normalization equations are definitionally c.Normalized.

The finite-boundary theorem applied to this normalized c gives FiniteChernNormalization. The Kummer-line tensor/Hom theorem applied to the same c gives Nonempty Twisting. Together with c and its normalization these are exactly the existential conclusion.

proof_origin.place: clauses (1)--(4); explicit tower Kummer construction, normalized scalar-unit proof, and separate integral reduction, finite evaluation and line-twist steps

theorem exists_diagonalTraceChernTwist (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) :
    ∃ c : Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T,
      c.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) ∧
      FiniteChernNormalization l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c ∧
      Nonempty (Twisting l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c)
